guidance.statement: Target sustainable high-teen growth and mid-teen to high-teen ROE.
guidance.target: high-teen growth, mid-teen to high-teen ROE

guidance.statement: To reach 1 million agents in the next two years, adding 1 lakh agents annually.
Insurance revenue growth to reach 15-16% through FY27 and rise further in FY28
Expense ratio improvement of 30-40 bps a year
Net reinsurance cost to fall to 0.5-0.6% from about 0.9% in FY26
Steady-state ROE of mid- to high-teens

operating_notes.text: Retail Health market share at 31.3% in FY26; 2.8 crore lives covered, 15,000+ hospital partners, 900+ offices.
New-to-insurance mix was 94% of fresh additions in H2 FY26 and 93% for the full year.
SME segment contributed 78% of group health business in FY26, up from 58% in FY25.
Health insurance industry typically witnesses higher claims during monsoon period due to rainy season related diseases
Long-term policies are about 40% of fresh retail premium, which delays revenue recognition over 2-3 years.
Agency network reached 8.5 lakh agents after adding about 20,000 in Q1FY27, with agent productivity up 19% YoY.
D2C fresh business grew 142% YoY, with 98% of those customers new to insurance.

holders.name: ICICI PRUDENTIAL LIFE INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED

timeline.summary: Star Health reported FY26 GWP of ₹20,369 Cr, up 16% YoY, with underwriting profit turning positive at ₹206 Cr and combined ratio at 98.8%.
Star Health reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹4,917 Cr and PAT of ₹550 Cr, marking a turnaround from the prior quarter's loss
Star Health reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹4,917 Cr and PAT of ₹550 Cr, marking a turnaround from the prior quarter's loss
Star Health reported Q1FY27 results with PAT of ₹550 Cr and CISR of 97.0%, reflecting improved underwriting and investment performance.
Star Health submitted application to BSE and NSE on August 3, 2026 for reclassification of promoter group entities to public category under SEBI LODR Regulation 31A(8)(c).
2026-08-14: Star Health submitted application to BSE and NSE for reclassification of promoter group entities to public category under SEBI LODR Regulation 31A(8)(c)
2026-08-26: Star Health receives IRDAI directions on policy portability and claims settlement for FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26
Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited’s 21st AGM on August 28, 2026, approved re-appointment of Mr. Deepak Ramineedi (DIN: 07631768) via 99.59% vote in favor.
Star Health held its 21st AGM on August 28, 2026
Star Health withdrew its reclassification application for promoter group entities; Industrial Glass Fiber Industries and Interics exit immediately, IDC Electronics remains.
Star Health received a reclassification request from promoter group entity Sthitaprajna Advisors LLP on September 30, 2026.
2026-10-01: Star Health's AA+ issuer rating and AA subordinate debt rating reaffirmed with Stable outlook by India Ratings
